mapper.sql: P.PLAN_NO, P.TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, P.COURSE_NO, P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, P.COURSE_NUMBER, TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_STARTDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS PLAN_STARTDATE, TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_ENDDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS PLAN_ENDDATE, P.CLASS_HOUR, P.CLASS_UNIT, P.PERIOD_TIME, P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_FORM_CODE_NAME, P.ISNOT_APPLY, P.DES_DEPARTMENT, P.DES_EMPLOYEE, P.DES_EMPLOYEE_NAME, P.BUDGET, P.BUDGET_SHOW, P.DEPART_MANA_CODE, GET_DEPT_NAME(P.DEPART_MANA_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPART_MANA_CODE_NAME, P.TEACHER_NAME, P.TEACHER_NAME_EMPID, P.TRAIN_ADDRESS, P.TRAIN_PERSON_COUNT, P.TRAIN_PERSON_REMARK, P.ISNOT_EVALUATE

mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_PLAN_MANAGER SET PLAN_STARTDATE = TO_DATE(#{planStartdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), PLAN_ENDDATE = TO_DATE(#{planEnddate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), CLASS_HOUR = #{classHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CLASS_UNIT = #{classUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_FORM_CODE = #{trainFormCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISNOT_APPLY = #{isnotApply, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DES_DEPARTMENT = #{desDepartment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DES_EMPLOYEE = #{desEmployee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DES_EMPLOYEE_NAME = #{desEmployeeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BUDGET = #{budget, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BUDGET_SHOW = #{budgetShow, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DEPART_MANA_CODE = #{departManaCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEACHER_NAME = #{teacherName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEACHER_NAME_EMPID = #{teacherNameEmpid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_ADDRESS = #{trainAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_PERSON_COUNT = #{trainPersonCount, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_PERSON_REMARK = #{trainPersonRemark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISNOT_EVALUATE = #{isnotEvaluate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CREATE_DATE = SYSDATE, CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CREATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT S.SYLL_NO, S.PLAN_NO, S.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(S.COURSE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS COURSE_DATE, TO_CHAR(S.COURSE_START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS COURSE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(S.COURSE_END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS COURSE_END_DATE, S.DETAIL_ADDRESS FROM EDU_TRAIN_SYLLABUS S WHERE S.PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND S.ACTIVITY = 1 AND S.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY S.COURSE_DATE, S.COURSE_START_DATE
